description: This PHP source file defines the DataGroupPermissionCollection class, which manages a collection of resource permissions related to data groups in the OrangeHRM system. It provides a method to convert permissions into an array format suitable for serialization or further processing.

classes.name: DataGroupPermissionCollection
classes.description: A collection of resource permissions specific to data groups, capable of providing these permissions as an associative array.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the permission collection into an array where each key is a data group and the value is an associative array indicating read, create, update, and delete permissions.
